entities.summary: Uýra is a Brazilian Indigenous travesti artist (two-spirit) also known by the stage name Uýra Sodoma. She holds a degree in biology and a master’s degree in ecology, and works in the field of art education. Uýra advocates for LGBTQIAPN+ rights and for the protection of the Amazon rainforest.
